headline: Queue verified empty — the TidyBot reskin is in flight
lede: Slot b's kick targeted #3078, but slot a won the claim race minutes earlier and is building it now: a papercraft-diorama alternate skin for TidyBot, gameplay untouched, switchable with a toggle or ?style=reimagined. The rest of the board is provably dry — every honest gap on all 66 registry titles is closed, blocked, disclaimed or owned, re-verified live on e550647. With four non-game merges in a row, the board now waits on Jon at #3079: name a new flagship title or call STALLED.

notes.text: Dry shelf re-verified independently: 31 open issues fetched clean, flagship and never-dry rungs both null — STOP-at-NONE is legal, not a fetch failure.
Two-slot TARGET race (#1258) resolved as designed: forge-claim's newest-wins liveness held slot b off #3078, loser yielded to the ladder — no double-work on one issue.
Contra remains the shelf's deepest cabinet: frogmen, rappellers, BARRIER and popups all live in production after last cycle's runs.
